text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary -> prompt-route-new (revision f2b3a9). Canary: 10% traffic. CI: green. :rocket:

alice_oncall: seeing error spike on canary, 502s from prompt-proxy to model-host. Rolling averages: 0.5% -> 6.3% errors in last 2m. Latency also +300ms.

sam_sre: can you paste a sample stack/log? canary id?

alice_oncall: canary id=cr-2026-03-17-19:02. Logs:
```
proxy | 2026-03-17T19:04:12Z | upstream 10.2.5.12: read timeout
proxy | 2026-03-17T19:04:13Z | 502 prompt-route-new /v1/generate
```
Failures correlate with increased token churn on requests with long prefixes.

sam_sre: sounds like the new routing adds extra KV fetches that strain the model-hosts at 10% traffic. Recommend immediate ff kill for prompt-route-new. Want me to flip?

alice_oncall: please flip. I'll take first oncall actions and notify support.

sam_sre: running: `ffctl toggle prompt_route_new off --reason \"canary 502 spike\" --now`

incident-bot: Feature flag \"prompt_route_new\" set to OFF by sam_sre at 2026-03-17T19:05:01Z. (change id: chg-7f3b)

alice_oncall: confirmed — error rate back to baseline within 45s. Canary traffic routed back to stable prompt-route. :white_check_mark:

maria_pm: thanks — any customer-visible impact? which customers hit canary?

eve_support: pulled support logs — ~12 active sessions from beta customers (alpha partners) saw degraded responses, ~3 reported timeouts to frontend. No wide CSAT hits yet. We should send a patch note.

nate_platform: collecting metrics for RCA. Initial note: model-host CPU went to 98% on a subset of instances, KV cache miss rate spiked. Saving metrics to https://internal.metrics/5620004321 (link).

sam_sre: tagging this as P1-> mitigated by ff-kill. Next steps: rollback canary deploy (or disable/replace new routing code) and patch the KV logic. Suggest create follow-up runbook and postmortem.

lucy_eng: I can reproduce locally with a long-context test harness; looks like cache warm path isn't short-circuiting. Will follow up with a fix branch.

alice_oncall: handing off to nate_platform for ongoing RCA and postmortem. I'm un-paging in 10m unless escalated. @nate_platform you're oncall for post-incident.

nate_platform: ACK. I'll coordinate with lucy and sam, will open incident ticket and schedule a 30m bridge for impact owners.

eve_support: preparing a short customer-facing note: \"We briefly routed some beta traffic to an experimental prompt routing which caused timeouts for a small number of alpha users. The issue has been mitigated and traffic reverted to the stable route. We're investigating and will follow up.\" Will send on approval.

maria_pm: please share the note in #customer-comm once ready. Also add any affected org names (if allowed).

sam_sre: confirm: no broader rollout. We'll gate the next attempt behind a stricter canary (1%) and instrument KV hit ratios.

alice_oncall: adding quick action items: 1) FF off (done) 2) Revert canary deployment (in progress) 3) Metrics dump to incident ticket 4) Customer note drafts 5) RCA owner assigned (@nate_platform).

incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-5620 created by alice_oncall. Severity: P1 (mitigated). Link: https://incidents/INC-5620

nate_platform: will run full host profile and post findings to INC-5620. Leaving this thread open for updates. Thanks team. :handshake:
